from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》' or case name)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The case cause (案由) or nature of legal dispute described in the document (e.g., '财产损害赔偿纠纷', '房屋征收补偿')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
